emails.subject: Frontend Developer Opportunities at Example Technologies

paragraphs: I’m reaching out to express my interest in frontend developer opportunities at Example Technologies.
I enjoy building responsive and accessible web applications and would welcome the opportunity to contribute to your team.
I’ve attached my resume for your review. I’d be glad to share more about my experience and discuss any suitable openings.
Please let me know if there’s a convenient time to connect.
body.closing:
Thank you for your time and consideration.

Best regards,
Mahendra Singh Puniya
